kredarica-mt-triglav-se: Kredarica is the mountain hut and weather station just below the summit of Triglav, the highest mountain in Slovenia at 2,864 m. The hut stands at about 2,515 m and is the usual last stop for climbers heading to the top.
kredarica-mt-triglav-e: Kredarica is the mountain hut and weather station just below the summit of Triglav, the highest mountain in Slovenia at 2,864 m. This camera looks east from the hut, which stands at about 2,515 m.
waimakariri-river-bridge-sh1: This is the bridge that carries State Highway 1 over the Waimakariri River just north of Christchurch, on New Zealand's South Island. Locals call the river the Waimak. It is the main road north out of the city, so the camera is a quick way to check the traffic.
lom-b-verdalen-leirvassbu: Leirvassbu is a mountain lodge at about 1,400 m above the Bøverdalen valley, in Lom in Norway. It sits in the middle of Jotunheimen, the country's highest mountain range, and is a base for hikers in summer and ski tourers in spring.
duffey-lake-road-cayoosh-summit-hwy-99: The Duffey Lake Road is the stretch of Highway 99 between Pemberton and Lillooet in British Columbia. Cayoosh Summit is its high point, and the camera is there for drivers checking snow and road conditions before they set off.
rochehaut-south-frahan: Rochehaut is a village high above a tight loop of the River Semois, in the Belgian Ardennes. The view from the top looks down on the hamlet of Frahan, tucked inside the bend of the river. It is a well-known viewpoint in Belgium.
oukaimeden-south-east-observatoire-trapp: Oukaïmeden is a ski resort in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco, about 75 km south of Marrakech, at around 2,600 m. The camera is named for the Oukaïmeden Observatory, home of the TRAPPIST-North telescope.
karpacz-east-dom-l-ski-karpacz: Dom Śląski is a mountain hostel on the saddle below Śnieżka, the highest peak of the Karkonosze mountains at 1,603 m, on the border between Poland and Czechia. Walkers pass it on the way up from Karpacz.
dublin-west-gpo-museum: The General Post Office on O'Connell Street is one of Dublin's best-known buildings. It was the headquarters of the 1916 Easter Rising, and it still works as a post office today, with a museum inside.
murnau: Murnau am Staffelsee is a market town in Upper Bavaria, Germany, at the edge of the Alps. On a clear day the mountains fill the horizon behind the town.
naselje-risovac-blidinje-ski-resort: Risovac is the ski area in Blidinje Nature Park, a high plateau between the Čvrsnica and Vran mountains in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
hulst: Hulst is a small fortified town in Zeelandic Flanders, in the far south-west of the Netherlands near the Belgian border. It is still ringed by its old ramparts.
galway: Galway is a harbour city on the west coast of Ireland, where the River Corrib runs into Galway Bay. This one is live video.
us-395-conway-summit: Conway Summit is the highest point on US Route 395, at about 8,140 ft (2,480 m), just north of Mono Lake in California's Eastern Sierra. Caltrans runs the camera so drivers can check for snow before they travel.
point-reyes-national-seashore: Point Reyes National Seashore is a stretch of wild coast north of San Francisco, in California. The headland is one of the foggiest and windiest places on the Pacific coast of the USA.
sequoia-kings-canyon: Sequoia and Kings Canyon are two neighbouring national parks in California's southern Sierra Nevada. They are home to the giant sequoias, including General Sherman, the largest tree on earth by volume.
coquihalla-great-bear-snowshed-hwy-5: The Great Bear Snowshed is a concrete avalanche shelter on the Coquihalla Highway (Highway 5) in British Columbia, between Hope and Merritt. This stretch is known for heavy snow in winter.
cradle-mountain-lake-saint-clair-nationa: Cradle Mountain–Lake St Clair National Park is in the highlands of Tasmania, Australia. Cradle Mountain is the start of the Overland Track, a walk of about six days through the park.
